title: Gotrade Daily: Nvidia's First Report Without Huang Tonight
summary: Nvidia reports its first quarter since Jensen Huang stepped down. Before the open: Home Depot, Disney and October US retail sales.
body_markdown:
### New US chip export rules


The Commerce Department on Monday began requiring licenses to export advanced chips to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/nvidia-commerce-china-lutnick.html) . The rule closes a gap that let Chinese companies lease Nvidia computing power from data centers in third countries.


CNBC said shares of Nvidia, Micron, Intel and AMD fell after the rule was announced. At Monday's close, **AMD ([AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) )** was down 5.58%, Micron 7.62% and Intel 7.02%, according to Nasdaq data. More in[our Nvidia story](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-17-2026/) .


### Home Depot, Disney and US retail sales


**Home Depot ([HD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/hd/) )** and **Disney ([DIS](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/dis/) )** report before the open, according to CNBC. EPS estimates are $3.87 and $1.67,[according to Nasdaq's earnings calendar](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/earnings) .


October retail sales are due at 8:30 a.m. ET, with economists polled by Dow Jones expecting a 0.2% gain, according to CNBC. The week's full calendar is in[our weekly outlook](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/weekly-economic-outlook-2026-11-16/) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


Dow futures rose 0.02%, S&P 500 futures 0.06% and Nasdaq 100 futures 0.1% on Monday evening in New York,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) .


## Macro Note 📝


The 10-year Treasury yield eased 3 basis points to 5.12% on Monday,[according to the US Treasury](https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve&field_tdr_date_value_month=202611) . Minutes of the Fed's October meeting come out Wednesday, and[Anthropic](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/anthropic-ipo-date-price-range-founder-control/) is expected to start trading Thursday,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/anthropic-sets-price-range-of-70-to-78-in-upcoming-ipo.html) .


## Conclusion


Tonight the market has two tests: retail sales before the open, then Nvidia's report after the close. The results are the first under the company's interim leadership, after new export rules weighed on chip stocks.


US markets open at 9:30 a.m. ET, an hour after the retail sales data.
